description: USDC a seller sent back to one of your wallets, read from Base. 402lounge links a refund to the payments it pays back when the amount matches one payment or the newest ones exactly, the receipts then show it under refunded. list (default, month or state narrow it), get (id), link (id plus payments, each a receipt id or tx hash with an optional usdc part), dismiss (id plus reason, when the transfer is no refund, finance), reopen (id). Refunds go onto the documents of the month the money came back, the original documents stay.

action.description: list (default), get, link, dismiss or reopen

before.description: list: page, the smallest refund id of the previous page

id.description: get, link, dismiss, reopen: the refund by id or 0x transaction hash

month.description: list: refunds that came back in this month, like 2026-11

payments.description: link: the payments the refund pays back

receipt.description: Receipt id or 0x transaction hash of the payment

usdc.description: The part of the refund for this payment, like "0.002". Default: what is left of the payment

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

reason.description: dismiss: why the transfer is no refund, 3 to 500 characters

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

state.description: list: only refunds in this state, open ones need you

name: receipts.refunds
title: Refunds sellers paid back
